title: Prompt chips to a running pipeline
summary: A dark prompt card gets a task, the camera pushes onto its context chip and pans across two dropdowns, then a tile library pulls out under a build button and a status-dot pipeline lights up stage by stage.
use_when: An AI or vision tool where the user picks sources and a model before a job runs
Showing setup (prompt, device, camera) and the resulting run in under 7 s
Small UI that must stay legible: the camera pushes in instead of scaling the UI
A serious, no-bounce product voice: 2-3 fr fades and damped camera moves

look.type_style: neutral grotesk (Inter-like), sentence case; prompt and card titles 600 about 2.5 % H at 720p, stage labels 600 about 1.4 % H, muted 400 sub-lines; tiny tracked uppercase mono-like tile labels

sfx.event: cursor click on a dropdown option, check appears
build button pops over the dimmed grid

structure.shot: dark prompt card on a soft chrome-pink backdrop: upload strip, one-line task, context chip, model picker, send button; two dropdowns open
structure.camera: zoom-tier full -> element: push-in 1.0 -> 1.6 on the chip at f30-39 (springs.cameraIn, 9 fr); dolly right to the second dropdown at f60-72 (springs.ui, 10 fr)
structure.motion: card rises 6 fr (easings.outExpo); task typed by f15; chips fade together f15-24; send button at f23 (+-0.25 s); first dropdown 3 fr fade with 6 px drop at f25-27; second dropdown same 3 fr fade at f66-69 (+-0.25 s); cursor-path to the first option, click f78-84; check fades in 2 fr f84-85

structure.shot: black field with a 6x4 grid of dark model tiles, each with a tiny uppercase label; an accent build button pops in the middle and the grid dims
structure.camera: pull-out: tiles shrink about 25 % from f95 to f114 (springs.cameraOut, about 19 fr, +-0.25 s), then hold (drift -1.8 %/s)
structure.motion: grid present at the cut, no stagger visible (+-0.25 s); build button springs.pop at f132-135 (overshoot not measurable); grid tiles and labels dim to about 35 % over f135-143 (easings.outQuint, +-0.25 s); hold to f173

structure.shot: light chrome backdrop; a dark card with a short title and a rail of three status-dot stages (done, running, queued), each with a sub-line
structure.camera: drift: card rises about 12 px and settles by f180 (springs.ui, +-0.25 s), then hold
structure.motion: card fill fades light grey -> dark in 3 fr f173-175; title types from f173; stages light 7 fr apart (f176, f183, f190): dot dim 1 fr then full, label and sub-line type at 2 chars/fr with a 3-char trailing fade; dashed connector fills top -> bottom in 2 fr under a done stage; check fades in with the done sub-line; hold from f200 to the end

params.brand: any brand.json: surface for the cards, accent for the send and build buttons, fg/muted for type
params.content.task: one-line prompt, 4-6 words, what the system should find
params.content.chip: context chip label and its first dropdown (group label + one item)
params.content.options: 2 options plus an add-new row for the second dropdown; index of the clicked one
params.content.tiles: up to 24 short uppercase tile labels for the library grid
params.content.pipeline: card title + 3 stages {label, sub, state done|running|queued}
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16; push the camera in instead of shrinking the UI

notes: Measured at 30 fps by a human pass plus 4 fps sheets: dropdowns open in 3 fr with a 6 px drop and no scale; push-in 1.0 -> 1.6 in 9 fr, pan 10 fr, both critically damped; check fades in 2 fr, no pop; pipeline stages 7 fr apart, labels type at 2 chars/fr with a 3-char trailing fade. Nothing bounces except the build button. Frame 0 is black, picture from f1. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Proposed term status-pipeline (rail of status dots that lights stage by stage) is not in the vocabulary; list-assemble used as nearest id. Draw our own chip glyph.
